title: SSE question frame
description: A `question` frame on a turn stream — a structured question raised by the Core `ask_user` mechanism that blocks the interactive turn until answered or cancelled. The `data.question_id` is a REQUIRED correlation id: a client answers the blocking question by posting it back through the Core `submitTurnAnswer` operation (POST /sessions/{id}/turns/{turnId}/answer), which is reachable without the optional `questions` profile. The `id` mirrors the SSE `id:` transport cursor (see sse-frame.json); it is not part of `data`.

event.description: SSE event name for this frame.

question_id.description: Correlation id echoed back when answering (submitTurnAnswer body).
